title: Cellforge
description: A multi-sheet spreadsheet with a from-scratch formula engine — hand-written lexer, Pratt parser, evaluator, and one live dependency graph with topological recalc + cycle detection. NEW v10 — a FIXED-INCOME SECURITIES engine built from first principles: all five Excel DAY-COUNT bases + COUPON scheduling (YEARFRAC/DAYS360/COUPPCD/COUPNCD/COUPNUM/COUPDAYBS/COUPDAYS/COUPDAYSNC), COUPON-BOND analytics (PRICE, a root-solved YIELD, Macaulay + modified DURATION), ACCRUED interest (ACCRINT/ACCRINTM), DISCOUNTED money-market securities (DISC/PRICEDISC/YIELDDISC/INTRATE/RECEIVED + the T-bill trio TBILLPRICE/TBILLYIELD/TBILLEQ) and INTEREST-AT-MATURITY securities (PRICEMAT/YIELDMAT) — a flagship three-sheet Bond Lab prices a coupon bond from its yield, spills the coupon schedule whose present values sum to the dirty price to the penny, and cross-checks a T-bill three ways. On top of v9's FINANCIAL MODELING (TVM off the annuity master equation, DCF with XNPV/XIRR/MIRR, depreciation); v8's INFERENTIAL STATISTICS + a SPECTRAL layer (Jacobi eigen, SVD, QR eigenvalues, pseudo-inverse); v7's REGRESSION (LINEST off a Householder QR) + dense MATRIX ALGEBRA + statistical DISTRIBUTIONS; v6's MIXED-INTEGER PROGRAMMING + SENSITIVITY REPORT; v5's SIMPLEX Solver; v4's spill-range refs (A1#), pivots, recursive lambdas; v3's dynamic arrays, LAMBDA/LET + MAP/REDUCE and Goal Seek; cross-sheet refs, named ranges, undo/redo, Excel dates, ~300 functions, draggable SVG charts and find & replace. 384 in-app engine self-tests.
